blocks.text: clamp chooses a value between a minimum and maximum. It can let a heading grow gently as the viewport grows.
Use the runnable HTML examples here, then resize a local browser page or its device preview. The CSS examples are inside each small page, so no framework is required.

items: `clamp(minimum, preferred, maximum)` keeps a flexible value inside readable lower and upper limits.

blocks.text: The heading scales with the viewport but stays between 1.5rem and 3rem.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not use only viewport units for all text. Keep readable limits and check browser zoom.
